parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the automated response rule.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management hub for threat analysis is located. Select the region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: your assets are in a region outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this ID to switch to the perspective of the member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.
